terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: bash .cursor/start.sh && cd web && npm run dev
terminals.description: Next.js dev server on http://localhost:3000. start.sh brings up local PostgreSQL (and warns if the remote DATABASE_URL is unreachable), then predev runs the bootstrap check + tenant migrations against whichever DATABASE_URL is active (shared remote dev DB when the secret is set, local DB otherwise).
